name: demote-authority-production-receipt-core
title: Demote Authority production receipt from local admissibility core
description: Move Authority Server production receipt completion out of the local CLI core path. Local proof admissibility should report admissibilityStatus, assuranceLevel, and evidenceScope while keeping authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone as legacy/external adapter fields that default false and are not required for local DONE.
